headline: A routine deal step: Viatris starts its $36.50 cash tender for Pacira, as agreed; the stock sits at $36.38
reasoning: Source: Viatris's release on PR Newswire: 'commenced a tender offer to purchase all issued and outstanding shares of Pacira BioSciences ... $36.50 per share in cash ... scheduled to expire on November 16, 2026'. It follows 'the previously announced acquisition agreement'.
What changed: the agreed deal moved to its next step. Pacira closed at 36.38, a 0.3% spread to the offer, which is pinned.
objections: Routine step on an announced cash deal; price pinned to the offer.
